g.text: GDHUB-86 — the AI curator, from payment to the verdict

text.tspan: Curator's Review /workflow/cpN/review/K — one page for pro and ai
curator message (dark, the moment now) → goal → panel: tabs Plan | Review
+ switcher Start · Sprint 1–3 · Verdict (changes the panel only; later ones locked)
goal and tasks free to change; the first letter reads the goal
Model: per task {itemId, kind, note = what to do and why, suggestion?}
stored on the session's content.advice (hash: no repeat call for an unchanged plan)
AI sessions K = 2..4 with scheduledAt ≤ now,
= CallNotes shape (inShort, byTask, notShown, outsidePlan, focus, questions)
+ on K = 3: task advice (same shape as the plan feedback)

g.text: contentStatus back to null → the next run tries again
Letter to the team (bell + email): 'Sprint N review is ready' → /review/K

text.tspan: open from the review until endedAt + 24h
edit keeps originalText, remove = cut, done tasks locked
Day 29: moveFinishedToReview, then the AI checkpoint in Review
10.4: verdict line in the curator message

g.text: Verdict StageClosed ('Ready for the next stage')

text.tspan: Move to <next stage> (curator message, AfterVerdict, path Next stage row)
→ PUT /api/project/move (refuses when required stage tasks are open)
Plan Checkpoint N+1 on this stage / on your own
startedAt = max(chosen day, today) → dueAt recomputed
(00:00 UTC; for AI they are review days, not calls)

g.text: Goal + tasks: id, wording, done (readable artifact), cut, reworded
The sprint's artifacts: name + type + readable
Pulses: who worked, who was missing
The previous review: focus for this sprint

text.tspan: a purple ✨ line under each task (advice only, the author edits);
suggested tasks as rows with Add → changePlan
